svg.title: The factory loop: signals to verified deployments
svg.desc: The factory loop: primary sources feed ingest adapters; reconcilers, correlator and planner turn Signals into Tasks through the ledger; rd asks warden admit before it spawns Agents in herdr; Changes pass the verification ladder and the merge train to verified, held Deployments; Argo and Hermes are the doors, gateway CLIs sit beside.
